description: Department of Labour - Special allowance Payable to workers in the Cocoa, Cardamom and Pepper Growing and manufectaring Trade Cost of Living for the month of November 2017 being 128.5
categorisation: This gazette notification announces a special allowance payable to workers in specific trades (cocoa, cardamom, and pepper), which falls under public sector service conditions and benefits. It deals with wage regulations and worker compensation administered through the Department of Labour, making it a Public Service Gazette rather than a government personnel/structure matter or any other specialized category.
